Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a BRAND NEW production avatar atlas, using the attached image ONLY for its polished semi-realistic East Asian fashion portrait ART STYLE and rendering. Do NOT copy its characters or crowded layout. The previous sheet has repeated faces and every head is too high; BOTH flaws must be corrected.

Exactly 40 DISTINCT fictional adult people, 8 columns by 5 rows in identical invisible cells. Wide canvas with aspect ratio 8:5. NO extra people. Alternate man/woman across EACH row, 20 men and 20 women.
Composition is the top priority: EVERY person is a comfortably centered head-and-shoulders avatar with VISIBLE empty transparent space above their hair, about 15% of each cell. Crown y=15%, eyes y=45%, nose y=54%, mouth y=62%, chin y=70%, shoulders reach y=95%. Nose horizontally centered at x=50%. Full hair outline visible. Equal portrait scale. Each portrait fits entirely in its own square cell, small transparent side gutters and a clear transparent gap before the next row. Most heads fully upright, some gentle natural 3/4 views.
EXTREME IDENTITY DIVERSITY: every face has a different face contour AND distinct hairstyle. Mix broad square jaws, softly rounded faces, long narrow faces, tapered heart faces, wide diamond cheekbones, angular rectangular faces, different chin widths, cheek fullness, brow thickness, eye shapes/spacings, nose bridges and lips. No reused facial template. Changing clothes/hair color alone is NOT enough. Every hairstyle must have a different silhouette, cut, parting, bangs, texture or updo. Keep all subjects young adults, natural attractive faces, no identical twins.
Transparent alpha background; no checkerboard pixels, no circles, no colored blocks, no black or white backdrop, no frames, no visible grid, no labels, numbers, text, logos or watermark.
Sharp portrait detail, natural skin texture, fashion clothes and small accessories similar in polish to the reference. No excessive head tilt. Distinct identities more important than copying the reference.
Unique male haircut roster, in reading order of the male cells: neat buzzcut; textured French crop with straight fringe; high flat top; classic side part with low fade; swept-back pompadour; short tight curls; spiky taper; asymmetrical long side fringe; soft center-part curtain; subtle fauxhawk; close Caesar cut; messy short waves; slicked-back undercut; cropped silver curls; brushed-up quiff; short chestnut bowl cut; shaved side with diagonal fringe; tousled copper layered crop; short blue-black cornrows; long side-swept straight layers.
Unique female hairstyle roster, in reading order of female cells: sleek chin-length blunt bob; auburn pixie; shoulder-length outward flip; black high ponytail with full fringe; long loose brunette S-waves; short pink curly bob; side-braided blonde lob; dark brown low twisted bun; long black straight hair with center part; silver cropped shag; brown double braids; asymmetrical side-part bob; long burgundy spiral curls; short blonde finger waves; black high bun with wispy bangs; medium wolf cut; chestnut half-up bow; shoulder-length black soft curls; ash-brown slicked-back wet bob; long side-fishtail braid.
Assign each a clearly different facial contour, eyes/nose/mouth proportions. Do not repeat haircuts or facial identities.
